Kendraio App
============

Kendraio App is a highly configurable, highly customisable, open-source, no-code, bi-directional dashboard application.

- This is the web app, made from Flows. Click on the cog (top right) to see how the Flow works. Search the [Flow Cloud](https://app.kendra.io/workflowCloud/listWorkflows) to find other Flows.
- Website: https://www.kendra.io/kendraio-app
- Videos: https://www.youtube.com/kendraio
- Articles: https://medium.com/kendraio
- Read the documentation: https://kendraio-app.readthedocs.io

![Tests](https://img.shields.io/github/checks-status/kendraio/kendraio-app/main)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/package-json/v/kendraio/kendraio-app/main)

----------

- For help and support, join us on Slack: http://slack.kendra.io
